confirmatory_models.M1: one latent factor across learning and uncertainty indicators
confirmatory_models.M2: two correlated latent factors: learning/GCA and uncertainty/control
confirmatory_models.M4: trial-local associative opt-out model using difficulty, reinforcement history and learned values
confirmatory_models.M5: hybrid individual-factor plus associative trial process

forbidden_as_empirical_evidence: variables generated from the same latent parameter
primary_decision_rule: prefer predictive model comparison and calibration on held-out empirical data; do not declare a mechanism from variance explained alone
